💡 The novelty lies in coupling manifold learning with clustering to analyze spatially resolved high-dimensional Raman spectra of polymer solid-state electrolytes. This framework reduces dimensionality while preserving spatial-spectral relationships, enabling robust identification of surface heterogeneity. Its significance is providing a scalable, interpretable computational tool for mapping chemical and structural variations, advancing understanding of interfacial inhomogeneity in solid-state battery materials.

item.title: Reusable and Robust Hydrogel With Dynamic Sacrificial S─S Bonds: In Situ Construction of an Integrated SEI/Hydrogel Interface for Highly Stable Zn–I 2 Batteries
item.description:
ساخت درجای رابط یکپارچه SEI/هیدروژل PUMA با پیوندهای گوگردی دینامیک، پایداری و انتقال یون روی را در باتری Zn-I2 به‌شدت بهبود می‌دهد.
Angewandte Chemie International Edition | 🔬 Research Article

item.title: Amorphization Unlocks Active Sites in Organic Small Molecules for Ah‐Level Aqueous Ammonium‐Ion Batteries
item.description:
بی‌شکل‌سازی مولکول کوچک TDT با شکستن انباشتگی π–π، جایگاه‌های ردوکس مدفون را فعال کرده و باتری آبی آمونیوم-یون با ظرفیت Ah-level پایدار ارائه می‌دهد.
Advanced Materials | 🔬 Research Article
💡 Amorphous TDT disrupts π–π stacking, exposing buried redox sites (738 m²/g) and enabling 242.8 mAh/g with 87.1% retention over 817 cycles. It reveals NH₄⁺ coordination/deprotonation storage plus localized hydrolysis generating H₃O⁺. The first Ah-level aqueous ammonium-ion pouch cell (1.037 Ah, 1.14 V) demonstrates practical viability of amorphous organic small molecules for durable, high-capacity batteries.
🏷 ammonium-ion battery · amorphization · organic electrode · TDT molecule · active site

item.title: Machine‐Learning‐Potential‐Driven Volcano Relationship in Grain Boundary Amorphicity and Ionic Transport of Antiperovskite Solid Electrolytes
item.description:

Advanced Materials | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in using an actively learned machine-learning interatomic potential to link quantum accuracy with large-scale MD, revealing an MLIP-driven volcano relationship between grain-boundary amorphicity and ionic transport in halide-tunable antiperovskites. Its significance is establishing controlled anion segregation as a design strategy to reduce interfacial resistance and providing a predictive framework for disorder and transport engineering in solid electrolytes.

item.title: Cesium Tin Iodide Perovskites Engineer the Sn 4+ /Sn 2+ Redox Reaction in Aqueous Zinc‐Ion Batteries
item.description:

Advanced Materials | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in using in situ-grown CsSnI₃ and Cs₂SnI₆ perovskite layers to enable the previously unrealized Sn⁴⁺/Sn²⁺ redox couple in aqueous zinc-ion batteries, raising its potential to 0.39 V vs SHE. This yields dual-plateau Zn||SnCl₄ batteries with high areal capacity (0.80 mAh cm⁻²), energy density (0.99 mWh cm⁻²), and long cycling stability, offering a cross-disciplinary strategy for high-energy aqueous batteries.
